title: Eventar evidence claim
description: A single falsifiable evidence claim emitted by an Eventar evidence subagent. Compatible with the existing credit_ledger and freeze model. The four falsifiability fields are mandatory.

question.description: The permanently separate question this claim addresses. 1 approval, 2 completion, 3 acceptance.

subject_id.description: UUID of the claim subject. Accrediting body for Q1, practitioner licence for Q2, target authority for Q3. Never a person name.

status.description: Controlled status. Q3 accepted requires a confirmation artefact in evidence_refs.

evidence_refs.description: IDs or references substantiating the claim. Document ids, approval references, credit_ledger entry ids, confirmation artefact ids. No free text personal data.

rule_version.description: The frozen completion rule version, or the versioned mapping pack for a submission claim.

observation.description: First principle observation the claim rests on.

depends_on.description: States or other claims this claim depends on.

how_would_we_know_this_failed.description: Explicit falsification check. The condition under which this claim is wrong.

leading_indicator.description: Metric to monitor for early signs of failure.

human_review_required.description: True when a dependency is unverified or a required field is missing. Trips the orchestrator gate.

agent_version.description: Version of the emitting subagent, stamped at call time.

confidence.description: Optional model confidence. Never a substitute for the deterministic checks.
